item.title: OSA Sighted the Suhail Star Signaling the End of Intense Heat - Merge 104.8
item.description: Oman Astronomical Society issued a statement, saying that the Suhail star has appeared in Omani skies, which signals the end of the intense heat and the beginning of moderate weather.
